## App

- [ ] `database/apps/<id>/app.toml` lives in a folder named after its `id`
- [ ] Sources are listed in order of preference and every package exists (`python3 database/scripts/verify-sources.py`)
- [ ] The icon is the app's official icon, SVG or a PNG of at least 128×128, and its license allows redistribution
- [ ] `cargo build-index` succeeds
